dialogue.text: Grain rain, the last rain of spring.
dialogue.zh: 穀雨，春天的最後一場雨。
dialogue.ja: 穀雨、春の最後の雨です。
dialogue.local: Grain rain, the last rain of spring.
dialogue.en: Grain rain, the last rain of spring.

dialogue.text: Around April 20th is Guyu, grain rain.
dialogue.zh: 大約在四月二十日是穀雨節氣。
dialogue.local: Around April 20th is Guyu, grain rain.
dialogue.en: Around April 20th is Guyu, grain rain.

dialogue.text: This is the last solar term of spring.
dialogue.zh: 這是春天的最後一個節氣。
dialogue.ja: これは春の最後の二十四節気です。
dialogue.local: This is the last solar term of spring.
dialogue.en: This is the last solar term of spring.

dialogue.text: The rain at this time is perfect for growing grain.
dialogue.zh: 這時的雨水非常適合穀物生長。
dialogue.ja: この時期の雨は穀物の成長に最適です。
dialogue.local: The rain at this time is perfect for growing grain.
dialogue.en: The rain at this time is perfect for growing grain.

dialogue.text: Farmers plant rice and prepare their fields.
dialogue.zh: 農民們開始種植稻米並準備田地。
dialogue.ja: 農家は稲を植え、田んぼを準備します。
dialogue.local: Farmers plant rice and prepare their fields.
dialogue.en: Farmers plant rice and prepare their fields.

dialogue.zh: 茶葉和艾草綻放出絢麗的色彩。
dialogue.ja: お茶と艾（もぐさ）が鮮やかに咲きます。

dialogue.text: Tea picked before grain rain is the most precious of the year.
dialogue.zh: 穀雨前採摘的茶葉是全年最珍貴的。
dialogue.ja: 穀雨の前に摘まれたお茶は一年で最も貴重です。
dialogue.local: Tea picked before grain rain is the most precious of the year.
dialogue.en: Tea picked before grain rain is the most precious of the year.

dialogue.text: Fishermen celebrate two fish are plunk and plentiful.
dialogue.zh: 漁民慶祝魚獲豐盛，魚兒活蹦亂跳。
dialogue.ja: 漁師たちは魚が豊富で元気に跳ねることを祝います。
dialogue.local: Fishermen celebrate two fish are plunk and plentiful.
dialogue.en: Fishermen celebrate two fish are plunk and plentiful.

dialogue.text: Grain rain says goodbye to spring and prepares us for the warmth of summer.
dialogue.zh: 穀雨告別春天，迎接溫暖的夏季。
dialogue.ja: 穀雨は春に別れを告げ、夏の暖かさに備えます。
dialogue.local: Grain rain says goodbye to spring and prepares us for the warmth of summer.
dialogue.en: Grain rain says goodbye to spring and prepares us for the warmth of summer.
